people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
translations.bsb: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
translations.kjv: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
translations.asv: Henceforth, let no man trouble me; for I bear branded on my body the marks of Jesus.
